newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi says Italy needs more rate cuts.
newsitem.headline: Prodi says Italy needs more rate cuts.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi, speaking three days after the Bank of Italy cut the discount rate, said on Monday that there was a need for further cuts.

"There is a need for a reduction of the cost of money. This is not a polemic with the (Bank of Italy) governor but a reflection as an economist," he said at a conference of local industrialists in Bologna.
The Bank of Italy cut the discount rate by 50 basis points on Friday night. Prodi said shortly after the cut that he was "pretty happy" with the move.
Prodi and other ministers, along with business leaders and unions, had long urged Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio to cut interest rates in the face of steady falls in inflation.
Speaking in Bologna on Monday, Prodi said Italy's economic recovery was "still timid". He added: "I want to relaunch it and I can relaunch it." -- Rome newsroom +396-678-2501
